Two Jammu and Kashmir Police Officers Found Dead

Two police officers were discovered deceased inside a car in Jammu and Kashmir. The exact circumstances and cause of their deaths were not immediately known, according to sources. In a separate incident, a Haryana police officer was found shot dead inside a hut in Faridabad.
